0022600208.text: Denver (5-3) visits Houston (7-3) in the Nuggets' ninth game of the season, riding a two-game winning streak with a 3-1 road record and a 5-3 mark over their last ten, though they sit 9th in the West and 2 games back in the Northwest. Houston, 4-1 at home, has lost its last two games, sits 6th in the West and 1 game back in the Southwest, and is without Clint Capela (ankle sprain) and Steven Adams (calf strain), who are both out. Julian Strawther is out for Denver with a knee sprain, while Aaron Gordon, Cameron Johnson, Christian Braun, DeMar DeRozan, Jamal Murray and Nikola Jokic are all listed as day-to-day with game-time decisions, and the teams have yet to meet this season after the Nuggets won their March 11, 2026 meeting 129-93 in Denver and the 2025-26 series 3-1.
